description: Lebanese cooking centers on sumac and zaatar, pita, and olive oil. Shared plates, warm spices, and balance of grain, legume, and herb.

attributes.micro_lesson: Toast spices, use yogurt and tahini for richness, finish with fresh herb and pomegranate acid.
attributes.shopping_tip: Sumac, zaatar, bulgur, chickpeas, and flatbread are pantry anchors.
flavor_building: Start with olive oil as your cooking medium.
Season with sumac and zaatar — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around pita as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Lebanese food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
